받다.e: to receive; to get; to accept
받다.n: everyday receive anything — gifts, calls, lessons
cf: to welcome; to receive; to take in
welcome a guest inside — warm, written
official, take delivery of parcels or money
win or accept a business order — construction, trade
Receive something that was passed on through someone else, such as news or items; everyday and neutral.
accept applications or documents at a desk

중립성.n: Abstract noun with suffix meaning the quality of being neutral; used in analysis, media, or debate.
cf: Basic noun for a neutral position or stance, such as not taking sides; shorter base form.
a country that takes no side in wars
